items.title: 賛否両論のデムナの「グッチ」は10点満点中の何点？ 業界アナリストが辛口リポート
items.summary: Bernstein luxury analyst Luca Solca scored Demna's Gucci debut 7.6/10, using an AI-assisted methodology combining industry media sentiment with his own judgment. He called it "not a home run" but an improvement over predecessor Sabato De Sarno's 6.8. Jackets and trousers scored well; shoes and handbags were called boring, with leggings drawing particular criticism. The score trailed Dior (9.1) and Chanel (9.0) among recent debuts.

items.title: Gucci cuts prices, but will Chinese shoppers return?
items.summary: Gucci confirmed official price cuts in China of roughly 22-29% on select bags (e.g. Ophidia mini bucket bag down to 8,700 RMB) and about 30% on select dresses, swimwear and knitwear, following Louis Vuitton's lead. Gucci customer service called it a routine "market factors" adjustment. The piece frames deep skepticism: Chinese consumers are described as cautious, expecting further markdowns, and increasingly favoring gold over bags as a value store, raising doubt that price cuts alone will win shoppers back.

items.title: Gucci's New 'Made in China' Sneaker Breaks With Italian Tradition
items.summary: Gucci's new Drip sneaker (Demna's first sneaker for the house, part of the Primavera line, ~800 euros/$1,000) is manufactured in China, breaking with Gucci's Italian-made tradition. Gucci said Italy remains central to its identity but noted precedent working with Swiss/Japanese suppliers for watches and eyewear. Berenberg analysts warned of "tension between provenance and the luxury positioning Gucci is seeking to reclaim"; a Milan consultant was quoted saying "Made in China is not a good look." Context: Gucci is trying to reverse a steep sales decline and win back price-sensitive shoppers.

items.title: 古驰大地震：Demna降价30%关店百间，Q2降幅收窄至2%能翻身吗？
items.summary: Weibo commentary post recaps Gucci's overhaul under Demna: ~30% price cuts on new lines (entry bags cut from 2,500 to 1,750 euros), 75 global store closures over six months (40% in Asia-Pacific), Q2 revenue decline narrowing to 2% from Q1's 8%, but Kering group net profit fell 60% to 189 million euros due to margin compression and restructuring costs. Frames the question openly as whether these moves can reverse Gucci's fortunes. No engagement counts visible on the fetched page.

items.title: 古驰连降十季后大动作：Demna新设计降价30%+管理层换血，能否翻身？
items.summary: Weibo roundup describing Demna's "street-sexy" aesthetic (low-waist silhouettes, biker jackets, neon logos) as a sharp break from predecessor Alessandro Michele's romantic maximalism, with new pieces priced 15-20% below prior collections; cites the 1955 Horsebit bag dropping from 19,500 to 13,650 yuan on the China site. Also notes full management overhaul (new CEO Stefano Cantino), a licensing switch from Coty to L'Oreal for cosmetics, and a new Haas F1/Ferrari sponsorship. No engagement counts visible.

items.title: 싱글벙글 명품 브랜드 구찌 근황
items.summary: Korean community thread mocks Gucci's decision to introduce "Made in China"-labeled sneakers, framing it as a cost-cutting move forced by the brand's sales having "halved." Tone is derisive/critical, portraying the move as a compromise of luxury positioning. The post drew 145 recommendations and 256 comments, indicating meaningful community engagement with the controversy.

items.source: Yahoo! News Japan (via WWD Japan / Newscafe)
items.title: 山田涼介・戸田恵梨香、銀座で開催のグッチイベントに来場
items.summary: Gucci held "The World of Exclusive Creations," an event curated by artistic director Demna, at its Ginza location in Tokyo. Brand ambassador Toda Erika and "Friend of the House" Yamada Ryosuke (Hey! Say! JUMP) attended, generating celebrity/fan coverage of the brand's new creative direction. This is activation/promotional coverage rather than independent public sentiment.

items.title: 스트레이 키즈 리노, 구찌 앰배서더 발탁
items.summary: Gucci named Stray Kids member Lee Know (Lino) as a new global brand ambassador. Lino said he was honored to join Gucci's "creative journey," noting the brand bridges past and present. Gucci framed the pick around his artistry and individuality. Lino had previously attended Gucci's 2025 Cruise show in London. This is official ambassador/activation news, included for competitive context on K-pop ambassador strategy but flagged as brand-driven coverage, not organic sentiment.

items.title: 古驰国内外价差还有多大？降价40%后国内比欧洲贵多少？
items.summary: Weibo consumer-advice style post analyzes the remaining price gap between Gucci's mainland China and Europe pricing after the recent round of cuts (up to 40% on some items), estimating China prices are still meaningfully higher even post-discount and post tax-refund comparisons in Europe. Reflects ongoing price-conscious skepticism among Chinese luxury shoppers rather than celebration of the discounts.

items.title: グッチ、再び困難な時代に突入 一貫したヘリテージ戦略が欠如
items.summary: Nikkei Business analysis argues Gucci has re-entered a difficult period due to an inconsistent heritage strategy across successive creative directors, each reversing the prior direction, which it says has confused consumers and diluted brand coherence even as the house tries to stabilize under Demna. Represents a critical trade-press view distinct from marketing-driven coverage.

items.title: 11四半期連続マイナス、100店舗閉鎖＿いまグッチに何が起きているのか？
items.summary: Independent Japanese business blog post dissects Gucci's 11 consecutive quarters of revenue decline and the closure of roughly 100 stores globally, arguing the brand "half-collapsed" over three years and drawing management lessons for readers. Critical, analytically framed community commentary rather than brand-sourced content.
